commands.name: init-options
commands.description: List every supported Release V2 initialization choice; global --describe and --verbose add no command-owned detail

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Safely migrate a root V1 release configuration to V2; default output summarizes the result, global --describe adds the ordered plan and artifact facts, and global --verbose adds safe planning and write phases

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Preview the migration without writing files

commands.name: patch
commands.description: Create a patch release (x.y.Z); dry-run keeps the release preview, global --describe adds complete safe lifecycle facts, and global --verbose adds chronological execution phases

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Run without making changes

flags.name: unit
flags.description: Selects the release unit. Required when a V2 repository defines multiple units.

commands.name: minor
commands.description: Create a minor release (x.Y.0); dry-run keeps the release preview, global --describe adds complete safe lifecycle facts, and global --verbose adds chronological execution phases

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Run without making changes

flags.name: unit
flags.description: Selects the release unit. Required when a V2 repository defines multiple units.

commands.name: major
commands.description: Create a major release (X.0.0); dry-run keeps the release preview, global --describe adds complete safe lifecycle facts, and global --verbose adds chronological execution phases

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Run without making changes

flags.name: unit
flags.description: Selects the release unit. Required when a V2 repository defines multiple units.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Inspect the local release plan without tokens, journals, remotes, or execution; global --describe adds complete safe plan facts and global --verbose is a no-op

flags.name: change
flags.description: Requested version change to inspect: patch, minor, or major

flags.name: unit
flags.description: Selects the release unit. Required when a V2 repository defines multiple units.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Diagnose Release V2 GitHub Actions readiness; global --describe adds complete safe diagnostics, global --verbose is a no-op, and --verify-remote explicitly enables bounded GET-only reads

flags.name: unit
flags.description: Inspect one Release V2 unit while retaining checks for every unit sharing its workflow

flags.name: verify-remote
flags.description: Explicitly verify supported GitHub metadata with GET-only read requests

commands.name: units
commands.description: List the complete deterministic Release V2 unit inventory; global --describe adds complete safe unit facts and global --verbose is a no-op

commands.name: pipeline
commands.description: Inspect one Release V2 pipeline; default output is concise, global --describe adds all safe structured facts, global --verbose is a no-op, and --verify-remote explicitly enables bounded GET-only reads

flags.name: unit
flags.description: Selects the release unit. Required when a V2 repository defines multiple units.

flags.name: verify-remote
flags.description: Explicitly enables bounded GitHub GET-only verification and optional read-token resolution; the default remains local, offline, and token-free.

commands.name: ci-validate-context
commands.description: Validate dispatched Release V2 context against local config, state, HEAD, and tags; global --describe adds complete checks and global --verbose is a no-op

flags.name: unit
flags.description: Dispatched release unit id

flags.name: version
flags.description: Dispatched canonical semantic version

flags.name: tag
flags.description: Dispatched canonical release tag

flags.name: release-sha
flags.description: Dispatched full lowercase release commit object id

commands.name: github-workflow-init
commands.description: Create or preview the configured canonical GitHub Actions release workflow without overwriting different content; global --describe adds comparison and write-plan facts, and global --verbose adds safe execution phases

flags.name: unit
flags.description: Select a Release V2 unit and its configured workflow path

flags.name: path
flags.description: Select an exact repository-root-relative workflow path already configured by a Release V2 unit

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Preview exact generated workflow content without writing files

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Resumes a previously journaled V2 GitHub Actions release; default output preserves the recovery decision, global --describe adds safe journal/Git/recovery facts, and global --verbose adds chronological continuation phases. It never calculates a new version or automatically retries uncertain push or dispatch outcomes.

flags.name: unit
flags.description: Selects the release unit whose existing V2 GitHub Actions journal should be resumed.

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Assess the existing release journal without writing files, refs, journals, remotes, or dispatching.

commands.name: history
commands.description: Show the complete deterministic release history; global --describe and --verbose add no command-owned detail or logs

flags.name: unit
flags.description: Selects the release unit. Required when a V2 repository defines multiple units.

commands.name: contributors
commands.description: Show the complete deterministic contributor list; global --describe and --verbose add no command-owned detail or logs

flags.name: unit
flags.description: Selects the release unit. Required when a V2 repository defines multiple units.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate the complete release configuration; global --describe adds safe validation facts and global --verbose is a no-op

flags.name: show
flags.description: Display structured release configuration details and unit summaries

flags.name: unit
flags.description: Focus displayed V2 unit details; the complete repository is still validated.

commands.name: evidence
commands.description: Inspect concise release evidence classifications without mutation; global --describe adds complete safe evidence facts and global --verbose is a no-op

flags.name: family
flags.description: Filter evidence by family: release-execution, dispatch, migration, v1-compensation, or v2-pair-recovery

flags.name: unit
flags.description: Filter evidence records by release unit when the evidence family records a unit

flags.name: identity
flags.description: Filter to one Evidence record by an unambiguous 8-64 character lowercase hexadecimal identity prefix after family and unit filters

commands.name: evidence-archive
commands.description: Archive one exact completed evidence file through explicit guards; global --describe adds the existing safe write facts and global --verbose adds guarded phases

flags.name: family
flags.description: Evidence family to archive; only completed release-execution, v1-compensation, and v2-pair-recovery evidence are supported

flags.name: identity
flags.description: Evidence identity from inspection output

flags.name: digest-sha256
flags.description: Current evidence digest from inspection output; used to reject stale archive requests

flags.name: confirm-archive
flags.description: Required explicit confirmation for archive-completed

commands.name: plugin-index
commands.description: Generate, check, or explicitly persist the schema-v1 plugin registry index; raw mode ignores --describe/--verbose while check and persist use both

flags.name: output-file
flags.description: Write plugin-index.json to this file; omit to render raw schema-v1 JSON without persistence

flags.name: check
flags.description: Validate Plugin Index sources and schema without rendering or writing the artifact

flags.name: pretty
flags.description: Pretty-print raw schema-v1 JSON on stdout or in the persisted file

flags.name: repository
flags.description: Repository identifier to include in the generated index
